The frozen surface of Lake Ontario provides endless opportunities for beautiful scenes. The rising sun dresses an embankment, built from fragments of the disintegrating ice sheet, in a sea of golden light! #photography #nature #bluesky #naturephotography
#landscapephotography #landscape #sunrise
The Ice Witch returns... High winds and frigid temperatures make spectacular natural ice sculptures along the Lake Ontario shoreline. #photography #nature

On a winter morning, the frozen surface of Canada's Lake Ontario was covered in tiny ice crystals. With my camera on the ground, and a wide angle perspective, the sea of ice crystals played the starring role it deserved :) 📷 #photography #art #photoreel #nature #landscape #ice #Canada #winter

On a cold winter's morning, the frozen surface of Canada's Lake Ontario was covered in tiny ice crystals. In this wide angle perspective, the sea of ice crystals played the starring role they deserved! 📷🌿🖌️ #photography #photo #nature #naturephotography
#landscape #landscapephotography #ice #winter
Slushy water continuing to build ice shelves on Lake Ontario in Darlington Provincial Park.

The frozen surface of Canada's Lake Ontario is full of interesting textures and patterns such as this X-like shape formed by frozen breaks between beautifully textured ice shelves. 📷 #photography #art #photoreel #nature #landscape
#ice #Canada #winter
Lake Ontario shoreline in Darlington Provincial Park as the ice shelves & spouts are melting.

The winter landscape is as varied as the multitude of snowflakes and ice crystals that merge to form fanciful shapes and sculptures wherever you choose to look. We were delighted to find these impressive formations created by icy waves along Lake Ontario. #nature #winter #ice #photography
Lake Ontario shoreline at Darlington as the ice is building from the waves.
Icy Lake Ontario shoreline. Photos from a couple of years ago.

Frozen solid. A sailboat today frozen into Lake Ontario and looking a little under the weather near Toronto. Hopefully it might survive the coming pressures of the spring meltdown and not sink. #weather #winter #nature #naturephotography #sailing #Ontario #Canada 🍁
Icy wave remains on the Lake Ontario shoreline, for my texture loving peeps .bsky.social

“The Freeze-Up” Lake Ontario is making ice. There are huge chunks floating on the horizon, and gloomy skies, quite the sight, yet still lots of open water, despite frigid temperatures. #winter #lakeontario #ice #nature #visitthecounty #pec #edlehmingphotography #wintersky #sandbanks #photography
The ice, creaking and sighing as the water gently heaved. The breath of Lake Ontario.
Frozen shoreline of Lake Huron, at MacGregor Point Provincial Park, Ontario.

Around the Great Lakes of North America, winter brings cold winds, frigid water and a chance to see stunning formations called ice volcanoes. These ones are at the edge of an ice shelf approximately half a kilometre out! Lake Huron, Ontario Canada

Kirkpatrick / Blue Lake ice-out, 6-night spring canoe loop in the Algoma Region near Elliot Lake, Ontario, Canada via logging roads with .bsky.social was a tough one but well worth the physical effort on long portages and the bug-less but restless, nightly chill.
Ice circles on Lake Ontario near Scarborough, captured by jmrevasco2014.
Random fact (because I have ADHD and internet access 🤷‍♀️): Lake Vostok is a subglacial lake in Antarctica, roughly the size of Lake Ontario. It is covered by about 4 kilometers of ice.
Said ice house must have been built today because the only thing in that direction is Lake Ontario.

Frozen art, made by nature. 🧊 #ExploreCanada #WinterWonders

Lake Vostok, buried under 2 miles of Antarctic ice, rivals Lake Ontario in size but has been sealed off for at least 15 million years. Isolated from light and air, it harbors extremophiles — organisms adapted to extreme conditions. ↴ www.livescience.com/planet-earth...
Ice forming on Lake Ontario. This shot from the Lake House in Lincoln.
Kayaking Lake Ontario in January, roughly 20 years ago. The ice caves on the shore were ten feet high.
